narrative_markdown:
## Today's Forecast

Windier than yesterday; temperatures and cloud little changed. Largely dry, with thunder possible, peaking this evening. 31°C / 88°F high, 20°C / 68°F low. Sky partly cloudy early as reported, clear at midday and mostly cloudy in the evening. Wind NNE early and SW at midday; gusts to 41 km/h (22 kt). UV index 9.4 (very high). Air quality 222 (very unhealthy) at Kisumu Airport, the highest of 3 stations. As of 06:01, reports through 03:00: no rain; no thunder; high so far 20°C / 68°F; low so far 19°C / 66°F; peak sustained 11 km/h; sky partly cloudy.

## Extended Outlook

Temperatures and winds much the same through Friday, with showers and thunderstorms likely each day. Skies partly cloudy Wednesday, then mostly cloudy Thursday and Friday. Friday's call: rain, 65%, with three of four models wet; highs 29 to 32 °C. At this lead ICON has the best record, right 77% of the time over 66 checks.

Further out, becoming calmer through Tuesday, with showers and thunderstorms likely Saturday, dry Sunday with thunderstorms likely, and showers and thunderstorms possible Monday and Tuesday. Saturday: all four models wet, highs 28 to 30 °C. Sunday: three of four models wet, highs around 30 °C. Monday: all three models that reach it wet, highs much the same, thunder possible rather than likely.

Only GFS, ECMWF and ICON reach past Sunday. Tuesday's call: rain, 100%, with one of two models wet; highs around 30 °C. At this lead ECMWF has the best record, right 77% of the time over 62 checks.

## Severe Weather / Hazard Potential

Convective instability today: UKMO 3410 J/kg, ICON 2690 J/kg, ECMWF 2640 J/kg and GFS 1010 J/kg. Thunder likely; any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above the 41 km/h (22 kt) forecast.

## Winam Gulf — Conditions for Boaters

Peak gust 32 km/h (17 kt). Any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above this figure; the water is unsafe while one is nearby.

## Detailed Discussion

### Synoptic Overview

Across roughly 2,600 km, pressure is lowest toward the north (1008 hPa) and highest toward the southeast (1014 hPa) — a 6 hPa spread, a moderate large-scale gradient. The lower pressure to the north is deepening over the next three days. Pressure overhead is near-steady. Sampling is a nine-point ring at 12-degree spacing, so this locates a direction, not a centre or a front. Across the basin's 5 points, pressure today sits between 1012.4 and 1014.7 hPa, near-steady over three days (+0.2 hPa). Pressure here over the last 24 hours: -0.1 hPa.

### Forecaster Confidence Notes

On rain the record ranks ICON first at Day+3, right 77% of the last 30 checks and ECMWF first at Day+7, right 77% of the last 30 checks. On today's high UKMO is the warmest model at 31.3 °C and ICON the coolest at 30.1 °C; the call's 31.3 °C sits at the warm end. Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) calls a high of 30.0 °C and rain, agreeing with the call on rain. At Day+0, no model is meaningfully better than the others here yet. At Day+7, ECMWF is the strongest rain caller here and GFS the weakest. At Day+0, Best Match slightly under-forecasts peak wind here.

Figures issued 06:01. Written by code; a discussion follows when a model answers.
